air_analyst.description: character base voice: calm, authoritative documentary narrator, clear measured delivery, low steady pitch, serious but warm undertone

firm.ref_text: Air abolishes the exit. The wealthy family breathes the same poison as the street vendor outside its gate.

grave.ref_text: One point seven million deaths a year. That is more than a pandemic, sustained every single year.

somber.ref_text: Delhi residents lose about eight years of life expectancy to this air.

urgent.ref_text: Delhi recorded zero good air days in 2025. This is not a season, this is an emergency.

air_analyst.ref_text: Air is the system where the human cost is largest, and the least escapable. No one can decline to breathe.
